name: Wanaka Studio
summary: AI-native 3D game studio that turns a written idea into a playable browser game, with a visual editor.
description: Wanaka Studio is an all-in-one AI game engine: you describe a game, an agent builds a playable 3D version, and you can keep directing the AI or edit the world in a synced visual editor. No coding is required. The studio covers characters, environments, animations, audio and interfaces, with auto-rigging, multiplayer and one-click publish to a browser link. Official plans are Free, Pro, MAX and Ultra (monthly or yearly).

pricing.details: Free (60 credits/day); Pro 17 €/month or 13 €/month billed yearly (2,000 credits/month); Max 44 €/month or 36 €/month billed yearly (6,000 credits/month); Ultra 179 €/month or 143 €/month billed yearly (24,000 credits/month). Yearly billed as 2 months free. Plus applicable tax.
